description:
Build the Go API aggregation service that queries all upstream data sources and composes dashboard-ready payloads.

**Endpoints:**
- GET /api/v1/dashboards/mission-control — System overview: scenario counts, velocity, subscriber count, visitor count, backlog size + ETA, health status
- GET /api/v1/dashboards/hive — Scenario ecosystem: all scenarios with metadata, tags, completeness, status, dependencies, resource usage
- GET /api/v1/dashboards/forge — Engineering velocity: full swarm-manager stats (throughput, timing, blocking, agent, review), initiative health, governance, backlog composition
- GET /api/v1/dashboards/ledger — Revenue: subscriber counts by tier, checkout revenue, credit wallets, usage patterns, subscription status distribution, intro tracking
- GET /api/v1/dashboards/broadcast — Marketing: LPBS metrics (visitors, conversions, variants, CTAs), feedback counts
- GET /api/v1/dashboards/panorama — Aggregate: curated top metric from each other dashboard plus sparklines
- GET /api/v1/gaps — All gap/partial metrics grouped by dashboard with descriptions
- GET /api/v1/health — Health check with upstream connectivity status

**Infrastructure:**
- Connection clients for: LPBS (Postgres or HTTP), Swarm Manager (HTTP), Vrooli core (HTTP)
- Response caching with configurable per-source TTLs (suggested: 30-60s)
- Graceful degradation: if a source is down, return last cached data with staleness timestamp
- Each metric in the response includes a dataSource field: "live", "gap", or "partial"
- Concurrent upstream queries (fan-out/fan-in) for fast response times
- Structured logging for observability
- Circuit breakers per upstream source
name: command-center-api-aggregator
title: Build Go API that aggregates data from LPBS, Swarm Manager, and Vrooli core
